input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use covenant binding Bluefly. § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) is mutual and affirmatively preserves each party's freedom to contract with others; § 14.17 is a bare no-implied-licenses statement; and § 14.19 (Geographic Scope) limits only IBM's delivery obligations, not our activities. Searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "restrict", "shall not develop" and "Customer shall not" surface no covenant limiting the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build. The only Customer-side restrictions are ordinary license-scope terms — § 14.11 (no resale of IBM's Services) and § 12.1 (no reverse engineering/copying of Base Components) — which constrain use of IBM's own deliverables rather than our independent business, and § 11.2(a) is a representation, not a restrictive covenant. No redline required.
